verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents JavaScript scenarios that can click and fill form fields before returning HTML, plus custom cookies and premium proxies and auto-mode escalation for difficult sites. Together these let an agent scripted through the API handle simple form and consent walls, and possibly logins via cookies or filled fields, without manual steps. Nothing in the evidence documents CAPTCHA solving or a login-wall flow. Missing for 10: explicit CAPTCHA-solving capability, documented automated login/auth flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of bypassing walls.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically get past a CAPTCHA, login, or form wall without my manual intervention

citations.quote: If you want to interact with pages you want to scrape before we return your the HTML you can add JavaScript scenario to your API call.
Pass custom cookies to the webpage you want to scrape
Use premium proxies to bypass difficult to scrape websites
